name: albert
description: CONTAINS: consolidation of owner evidence into memory by a checked proposal, import of memory from existing files, and the review of open questions with the owner. PURPOSE: a published memory change, a no-change acknowledgement, or a refusal the caller can correct. ALWAYS LOAD WHEN: memory should be consolidated, reversed, reported, imported from files or reviewed with the owner. DO NOT LOAD WHEN: the task is a chat reply, a connection or a timer.
